shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Li Chenggang, China’s international trade negotiator and vice minister, met with a delegation of international business representatives on the morning of September 16, and the two sides exchanged views on China-U.S. economic and trade relations and other topics.

title: China's Li Chenggang Meets International Business Delegation on U.S.-China Economic Ties
